name: orvalha
title: Orvalha clinic sample
description: A finished bilingual sample site for a fictional neighbourhood health clinic: home, services, team, appointment request and contact pages in English and Brazilian Portuguese, with a designed theme, self-hosted fonts and its own photography. The appointment form asks for contact details and a preferred time only. Apply it to a new site to see what Viglet Shio renders.

pt-BR.title: Exemplo Clínica Orvalha
pt-BR.description: Um site de exemplo pronto e bilíngue para uma clínica de bairro fictícia: páginas de início, especialidades, equipe, pedido de agendamento e contato em português e inglês, com tema desenhado, fontes próprias e fotografia original. O formulário de agendamento pede só dados de contato e um horário de preferência. Aplique em um site novo para ver o que o Viglet Shio desenha.

assets.alt: A receptionist at a light wood counter greeting a visitor in a bright reception with plants and tall windows.
An empty consulting room with a light wood desk, two chairs and an examination couch by a window.
An empty physiotherapy room with a treatment table, folded towels, resistance bands on a hook and a wooden wall bar under a window.
A smiling woman in her fifties with short grey hair, in a white coat over a green blouse, a stethoscope at her neck, in a bright corridor.
A smiling man in his thirties with short dark hair and a short beard, in a navy polo shirt, in front of a wooden wall bar.
Three clinicians, two of them in white coats, talking together in a bright clinic corridor.
A calm waiting area with green armchairs, a low wooden table with a water jug, plants and a large sunny window.
The front of a white single-storey clinic building with a wooden pergola, a ramp and steps to a glass door, on a tree-lined street.
